identifiability.definition: frozen hindsight-free rule (protocol §7): firm + the product code's official generic device name, records published before the milestone

note: lead_days = milestone decision date minus the earliest verified evidence date. The publication clock uses first_posted / firstPublicationDate; the latest-plausible clock uses the largest available date field per evidence record.

L2_any_distinctive_token.definition: pooled rule as frozen: any distinctive token identity

L2_pre_regulatory.definition: no regulatory record of that product name existed before the evidence date

L2_product_specific_pre_regulatory.definition: product-specific token AND no prior regulatory record

L2_product_specific_token.definition: token used by at most 3 distinct applicants in device names (Amendment 2)

L2_strict_literature_rare.definition: the strictest conjunction: product-specific AND literature-rare token (not an ordinary word of the field) AND no prior regulatory record (Amendment 5)
